Deconstructing: two disassembled notched logs with a loosened fibre binding loop and a lifted wooden peg. Show separated joinery and slack lash, no hammer or saw or metal.

Digging clay: a broad wooden scoop lifting a heavy reddish-grey clay clod from a compact open clay lump; the scoop and sticky clay obvious, no earthenware bowl or metal.

Teaching stone craft: two hands, one larger guiding hand pointing to the facet of a broad grey flint core held by the smaller learner hand. One core, two hands, deliberate demonstration; no text, symbols, sleeves or metal.

Learning stone craft: one small open hand comparing a newly made grey flint flake with a larger finished exemplar flake positioned beside it, deliberate practice. Three large shapes only; no writing, text, school or metal.
Deer side profile with simple forked antler beside lashed grey flint-point spear.
Equipping: one bare hand clasping the wooden grip of a simple lashed flint axe as it is taken up. Grip gesture, whole compact axe fully visible; no person torso, metal or modern strap.
Two opposing bare hands exchange an ochre food root and a grey flint flake.
Harvesting wild plants: a bare hand pulling a broad edible root with two large sage leaves; one smaller root nearby. A clear uprooted wild root harvest, no cultivated grain, sickle or metal.

Tilling a field: a short stone-bladed hoe crossing two compact parallel soil furrows. Large grey stone blade bound by fibre to wooden bent handle, no metal; two separated short furrows only, no background tile.
Sowing a field: an open bare hand scattering five large ochre grain seeds in a descending arc toward two compact parallel earth furrows. No bag, metal or background plane.
Tending a field: one bare hand removes a small weed beside two sturdy green cereal seedlings with clear gap between weed and crop. Three simple plant shapes, roots visible, no metal watering can.

Harvesting a grain field: a curved wooden sickle with inset grey flint teeth cutting three ripe golden grain stalks tied in a compact sheaf. No metal, no loose berry or root, strong curved blade silhouette.

Capturing a young wild animal: a small standing tan goat kid calmly enclosed by a simple loose loop of fibre rope, loop open and safe around body, one short rope end. No cage, injury, metal, bells or dyed fabric.

Milking: a tan goat udder and one bare hand gently expressing a single milk stream into a simple undecorated clay bowl; crop at rear-body only so the milking action is large and clear. No metal pail or modern milking apparatus.

Livestock processing job: a simple broad chipped flint knife laid beside a neatly folded tan animal hide and a small hoof silhouette. Non-graphic still-life only; no live animal, blood, wound or body; no metal.

A crouching craftsperson beside a small clay smelting furnace with amber fire presents the first golden-brown bronze axe to a second clothed villager. Beside them a muted copper ingot, dark charcoal and a clay casting mould make the new material legible. A short low mud-brick wall fragment implies the material transition. No stone age scene transitioning through a magic portal; show one concrete moment.

Two standing adults exchange a bundle of dried fish for a basket of gathered berries between them. One is clearly a visiting trader carrying a tied hide pack at their feet; the other opens a welcoming palm. No currency, metal, market stall, or domestic grain. Keep both entire figures visible.

A worried seated adult tilts a nearly empty woven food basket, with exactly a few berries and roots visible. Another adult kneels beside a completely empty wooden bowl. Clear empty-container silhouettes communicate food shortage rather than starvation spectacle.
Firewood shortage: huddled adults, cold ash and spent twig, empty tilted fuel basket. No abundant fuel.

A family of three arriving travelers: two adults with tied hide bundles and one clearly shorter clothed child, greeted by a fourth adult with an open hand. All full figures, one walking staff, simple hide clothing, no metal or wheeled cart. Their grouping and carried household bundles communicate migration.

A gray-haired elder alone demonstrates careful flint knapping on a lap hide, with a flint core and hammerstone prominent; an empty low sitting stone beside the elder suggests no learner to inherit the skill. Reflective mood, no magic, letters, written scroll or book.

A kneeling craftsperson examines a broken stone axe: clearly separated chipped stone head, snapped wooden haft and loose fiber binding on a small hide mat; a second worker holds an empty hand. Sparse useful composition makes tool shortage immediately legible.

Two gray-brown wolves at the edge of a small camp face a wary adult villager who holds an unlit wooden staff defensively. The wolves stay apart from the person with readable muzzles and ears; a few hearth stones suggest the camp. Tense warning, no attack contact, wounds or blood.
Able adults quietly wait for work; still hands, divergent gazes, untouched stone adze and empty gathering basket.

Two standing adults argue over one gathered-root basket between them. Open palms and turned-away faces show disagreement, one third adult raises a calming hand. No weapons, punches, blood, modern gestures or speech balloons.
General PressureBegan preparation: alert lookout while another adult secures hide shelter over gathered provisions. Intended general hardship preparedness, not a specific pressure subtype.

A villager tries to set one basket beside three already crowded woven baskets and tied bundles under a short bark-and-pole drying shelter. The cramped storage is legible through overlapping containers, but each is anatomically readable. No metal, pottery, grain, warehouse or roof-cut building.
Gentle illness-care scene with water and herbs. Runtime sick_person is explicitly test_only at the source pin.

An adult in plain undyed plant-fiber wrap bends to scatter seed into two short tidy furrows while a second holds a woven seed basket. A wooden digging stick lies nearby. Large hand/seed gesture reads as spring sowing; no metal, dyed cloth, horizon, calendar glyph or rectangular ground tile.

An adult kneels beside a compact ripe golden emmer wheat stand and gathers a sheaf; a flint-inset sickle and tied sheaf are clearly visible in the foreground. Every blade is stone, clothing undyed plant fiber. The whole compact vignette communicates harvest readiness.
Undyed cloth shortage: tiny unfinished swatch, empty fiber basket and bare spindle, waiting resident in patched hide clothing.
First livestock kid: goat mother and small standing goat kid in a fiber-lashed pen with herder. This runtime ID does not mean a human birth.
Proposed future human birth card: fully clothed parents with a swaddled newborn after delivery. Distinct from runtime first_kid livestock birth.

Two anxious villagers behind a short wooden palisade gate look toward two approaching hostile silhouettes carrying simple stone-tipped spears and hide shields. The scene is a warning of a raid, no impact or injury; clear separate defender and approaching groups. No metal, horses, helmets, banners or battle gore.

One lone traveler with a walking staff and a small hide shoulder bag meets one resident at the edge of a stone-ring hearth. The traveler raises an open hand in greeting; both complete figures visible. Unlike migration, no family, luggage pile or trade goods.

An adult presents a smooth ground stone axe beside a freshly formed clay pot, while another adult tends a small patch of grain and a goat kid stands by a low wooden pen rail. A compact celebratory beginning of farming and settled crafts; undyed plant-fiber clothing, no metal or dyed cloth.

A smith in undyed wool tunic and leather apron uses a dark hand hammer on a squat stone anvil beside a small clay bloomery; a newly forged charcoal-gray iron axe and a rough iron bloom are prominent. Two short dressed paving stones imply the new road era. No steel chrome, industrial furnace, goggles or medieval castle.
Future proposed bronze-age card requested by C2 GOAL3.3: copper ingot beside an empty tin-side clay tray and unused mould, waiting for trader supply. Not an existing runtime card ID.

Food supplies running low: a tilted shallow woven reed basket, conspicuously almost empty with ONLY two small roots in its wide exposed dark interior. Broad empty cavity is dominant. Three broad weave groups.
Firewood nearly depleted: a single short split log with a tiny charred ember at its end. The lone log, rather than a pile, is the whole silhouette. Three broken bark strokes, no fire ring.

Sleeping without shelter: one small sleeping person curled in a rough undyed hide wrap, head resting on forearm, with a tiny pale crescent moon above. No bed or roof. Clear curled horizontal silhouette; face minimal.
Missing storage designation: four corner pegs and three sides of rope surrounding an empty transparent diamond.

Storehouse full: three tightly packed squat reed baskets beneath a tiny thatch eave, one basket overflowing with large round roots. Compact heavy silhouette; visibly crowded opening. No complete building scene.
Idle workers: a seated adult in an undyed hide wrap, elbows resting loosely on raised knees and hands empty, head upright. Quiet waiting posture, not sickness, no tool.
Unreachable work order: two simple human footprints approach a large cracked boulder blocking their path. Footprints stop before the boulder. No arrows, cross signs or map grid.
Waiting to learn: ear above receptive hand; semantic mnemonic with localized text, separate from discovery.
Technique loss risk: intact flint with severed fiber transmission loop; localized text supplies exact risk.

Danger of approaching wolves: one gray wolf head and upper shoulders, three-quarter facing viewer, alert pointed ears and slightly lowered threatening muzzle. Mouth closed, no blood or cartoon snarl. Three cheek fur tufts.

Migrants waiting: two simplified people shoulder to shoulder in undyed hide clothing, one adult carrying a bundled hide pack on a wooden staff, smaller companion beside them. Friendly waiting silhouettes, no landscape.
A trader is present: one compact open reed pack basket with two neatly tied fiber bundles and a pale flint blade set beside it. Travel pack silhouette and exchange goods, no coins or metal.
Person ill: a clothed adult head and shoulders hunched forward under an undyed hide shawl, one hand at forehead, exhausted closed eyes. No cross, thermometer, medicine bottle, droplets or text.

Person overwhelmed: a seated adult in plain hide clothing with both hands cupping the sides of their head, elbows flared and head bowed. Strong inward distressed pose, no tears or swirls or modern symbols.
Injury: bare forearm with broad undyed bandage and visible knot; no medical symbol or blood.

Stored meat spoiling: a single strip of dried meat hanging from a short fiber cord, uneven dark edge and two small pale green spoil spots. This is hanging meat specifically, not a basket or general food. No insects swarm.

Newborn has no sleeping place: a very small baby fully swaddled in an undyed hide wrap, asleep, lying alone with nothing beneath it. Rounded head above tapered bundle, three simple wrap folds. No bed, basket, moon, blood.

Food needed for winter: a half-full reed basket holding three roots with a small pale frost crust across its upper rim and one bare twig leaning against it. Frost and scant contents both clear, no snowflake symbol.

Food is spoiling: two withered berries and one shriveled root with a wilted leaf, one berry showing a muted pale green mold patch. Distinct from hanging meat. Keep large simplified silhouettes, no flies.
Human birth notification: a small sleeping fully swaddled newborn cradled gently in two adult hands. Plain undyed wrap, no bed, no blood, no scene. Warm quiet pose with only three cloth folds.
